description: This file defines the PaperBroker class, a simple implementation of a broker interface for simulation purposes. It manages fake account balance and positions, allowing to query and modify these states via methods like get_balance, get_positions, and place_order.

classes.name: PaperBroker
classes.description: A simple paper trading broker class for simulation, allowing balance and position management without real trading.

methods.name: __init__(self, starting_balance: float = 100000.0)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the broker's account state with a starting balance.

methods.name: float get_balance(self)
methods.description: Returns the current simulated account balance.

methods.name: int get_positions(self)
methods.description: Returns the current open position count.

methods.name: str place_order(self, side: str, quantity: int, price: float)
methods.description: Simulates placing an order by adjusting balance and positions based on side, quantity, and price.

ctags.name: place_order
ctags.pattern: /^    def place_order(self, side: str, quantity: int, price: float) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (self, side: str, quantity: int, price: float)
